title: Fleet slot recovery safety and native actions
description: ADR-042 Amendment 1 validation against disposable Git checkouts and an authenticated Companion. Start workspace.rpc.live.ts in UI-proof mode, authenticate an owned proof simulator, and set FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF_OUT plus FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_PROOF_DEVICE. The fixture caller owns teardown. This recipe covers recovery safety and native bulk/discard actions; unrestricted scored-selection proof is separate.

proofTargets.claim: Recovery verifies default HEAD and fixtures, binds discard to actual content, preserves retained evidence, and holds failed work until a guarded retry succeeds.
Actual Companion presses release safe idle slots, exclude unpublished work from bulk, preserve cancelled discard, refuse changed-content confirmation and complete freshly confirmed discard.

rpc-safety.cmd: FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF=0 FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_PROOF_OUT="${FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF_OUT:?Set the UI fixture output}/rpc" TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import tsx --test services/gateway/src/methods/slot/workspace.rpc.live.ts
rpc-safety.intent: Exercise authenticated gateway refresh requests and assert independent real Git, fixture and persisted-ownership effects.

native-actions.intent: Press the native fleet controls and verify safe bulk, cancelled discard, changed-content refusal and confirmed recovery through Git and persisted status.
